description: This file defines a template class 'MeasurementType' within the 'Thunder::Core' namespace, which provides functionality for measuring and tracking statistical data (minimum, maximum, last, average, count) for a generic data type. It includes methods for setting values, resetting measurements, and retrieving statistical metrics.

classes.name: MeasurementType
classes.description: A template class for measuring and tracking statistical data (min, max, last, average, count) for a specified data type.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the measurement statistics to initial state.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Updates the measurement with a new value, adjusting min, max, last, and average accordingly.

methods.name: Average
methods.description: Returns the average of all recorded values.

methods.name: Measurements
methods.description: Returns the total number of measurements taken.
